notes.title: Engine Upgrade
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35285204/1b009027777ad0f6172b1c93bfff07f6ddf1b60a.jpg[/img]
Happy Holidays!

After toiling away for a long time in the guts of the game our code monkeys have completed an overhaul of the game engine and bandwidth usage online.

You probably wont notice any difference to gameplay or graphics but you should see much reduced bandwidth usage and fewer drop outs.



Join our discord server and share your feedback and suggestions here:
https://discord.gg/cmqkdXA

Other Changes:
Added music for Baseball
Fixed pile up for clients
Made the net react to balls on super shoot
Shortened the duration of the bonus score time on Music Miner (same score)
Made the bonus audio 3D on Music Miner
Made retro road bonus time diminish each round
Made retro road audio ramp reset each round
Updated certain shaders
Correctly set throw boost default value
Fixed several localisation areas
OpenVR / Oculus / OpenXR update
Hide hands when holding an object
Teleporting / Walking only on the left stick
Turn / Snap turn only on the right stick
Updated tutorial info
Simplified finger pose sync

notes.title: Pierhead Arcade 2 Leaving Early Access
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35285204/0b69ef6ee23278216d83fd1a4b865d8f404d8dbd.jpg[/img]
[b]It's finally here folks, version 1.0![/b]
We feel the current state of the game has reached a level where we can take off the early access label.
So to celebrate we've added a brand new game to hall 2 and also 2 more toy grabber machines!
The toy grabbers have been moved to their own room to make space.


[b]What next?[/b]
It's been a hard year for the team and not just because of the pandemic but we plan on continuing to work on Pierhead Arcade 2 and its ports. The Oculus Quest 2 native version is shaping up nicely and will likely be on App Lab soon as well as other platforms. If you have game suggestions you can drop them over at our discord channel.

We've also been experimenting with different game mechanics for future projects / just for fun which you can see over on our discord / twitter account. Follow us there to keep up to date with future projects.

I'd also like to thank all our players for their support and feedback without which wouldn't be able be able to reach our goals. ːrocketballː

If you are a fan of the game then please consider leaving a review as that really helps us with the steam algorithm.  ːsteamthumbsupː

[b]
Full changes list:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added version filter to match maker
[*] Fixed daily challenge mode
[*] Switched to short estimate throwing for all headsets
[*] Tweaked screen fade effect
[*] Made shark teeth fold back when hit
[*] Made air sound quieter
[*] Fixed balls not spawning
[*] Adjusted spacing of machines
[*] Fixed lever twisting off axis
[*] Tweaked claw physics
[*] Tweaked mallet pose
[*] Tweaked shooting gallery pose
[*] Prevent teleporting with joysticks
[*] Let arctic shuffle end when pucks are short of the goal
[*] Tweaked highlight effect
[/list]

[b]Added music for: [/b]
[list]
[*] Dropmaze
[*] Labrush
[*] Longshot
[*] Ostrich Race
[*] Paintdrop
[*] Fantasy Flush
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes + Quest 2 port
notes.content:
As some of you know we've been working on a native Oculus Quest 2 port of the game and as such we've had to heavily optimise the game so it could run smoothly on the device. 
At the same time we didn't want to compromise on the experience and also allow cross platform multiplayer so the PC version of the game and the mobile version will largely be the same and the PC version will benefit from the performance optimisations.

If you would like to beta test the quest 2 version you can request access on the discord server.
https://discord.gg/9km8s7Xf6p

Also as a reminder the price of the game will increase after early access so if you've been waiting for release to get the game consider getting the lower price now as we near the finish line.

[*] Pixel smash correctly gives more points for different colours

[*] Performance optimisations

notes.title: New Game + Cosmos integration + LIV
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35285204/a18777d26964ef5134df1e98935f3d3076ad5d59.jpg[/img]
We have a new game for you to play plus a major overhaul.

In it you gave to use water jets to shove pearls into the correct holes.
Get multiple pearls correct for a score multiplier.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35285204/9a24da775b3290c2bff09b649b03b5769e8e8516.png[/img]

LIV support added (requiring a switch to 64-bit)
LIV lets you create mixed reality videos with a camera or avatar.
Get LIV here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/755540/LIV/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35285204/9467e9a0ad08059d37c17d8c3596728691e3f8b1.jpg[/img]

We have also added HTC Comos preview support. 
If you encounter issues please leave a comment.



Other Changes:
Leaderboard pop up is smaller.
Games will display a star when you unlock an achievement.
Removed the coin dispensers as they weren't really working out.
Originally you were going to carry buckets of coins around but the physics just couldn't handle it.
Games now payout tickets instead of coins.


We are going to add another room to the arcade after the holidays so look forward to that!

notes.title: Steam Spotlight + New Game: Wool Factory
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35285204/59928292d33bedf53316b4138378124eb362b1bc.png[/img]

Now would be a great time to pick up [b]Pierhead Arcade 2[/b] as we are being featured on [b]Steam's VR Spotlight! [/b]

View the rest of the sales here:
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/vr_specials/

On top of that we've updated the game with a new machine, a ball pusher!
Build up pressure by dropping balls into the same slots to get bonus balls.
Gold balls will roll towards the super bonus wheel.
Fill the super bonus bars for even more balls!

[b]Other changes include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaked pixel smash audio
[*] Network synced joysticks and levers
[*] Retro Road network sync
[/list]


[b]Join us on Discord:[/b]
https://discord.gg/cmqkdXA

notes.title: New Game: Pixel Smash
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35285204/a2cf6c10c551d8f61f874c40674a37345992fa93.png[/img]

Roll the ball up the ramp to hit the targets.
Clear all the red targets to change the grid.
Keep clearing grids for a high score.

Also entering a room will move your head to the starting position instead of your room centre (for people whose room centre is outside their play space)

Reintroduced the player scale slider for extra tall or short people.

Fantasy Flush card box always registers a card that's been placed in it (even if you take it back out).

Fixed Multiplayer not connecting.


If you're not already signed up here's a reminder to join our discord where you'll find a mock up of our new machine coming up next.

https://discord.gg/cmqkdXA

notes.title: Mega Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35285204/e201a995cb1dfc4964ff50f9fdf5051145dc6b55.png[/img]
Hi!

We have a huuuge update this time, after a lot of ground work we'll be able to more easily expand the game from here on out. We've also split off the coin pushers into their own room to help reduce the physics load in the main hall which means we'll be able to create more elaborate coin pushers in the future as well.

Here's a sample of some of the changes in this update:

[list]
[*] Sumo Bot ring now affects the physics of the balls
[*] Fixed Ostrich Racing race time UI
[*] Reversed the local scores of Ostrich Racing to reflect race times
[*] Removed networking features from single player
[*] You now purchase customisations from the photo room
[*] Removed customisations from the gift shop, freeing up space for new toys
[*] Created a separate achievement for customisations
[*] Added new squishy ball toy (works great with Index)
[*] Reduced rumble on Oculus controllers
[*] Added a recolour of toy helicopter (now you can race them!)
[*] Disabled walking while holding the toy controllers
[*] Fixed crouching
[*] Added hand model to all controllers without skeleton support
[*] Prevent rings from linking together
[*] Tweaked hand pose and snap points for many objects
[/list]

[b]New Games![/b]
[list]
[*] Hoopy Loopy
[*] Shark Attack
[/list]

[b]Coming soon[/b]
More coin pushers!

notes.title: Update 17/7/19
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35285204/160273508c0b44d4cf68cdbdbc6a1a89dfb272cd.png[/img]

Hello!

Thank you all for joining us on our early access journey and for your patience while we iron out the early bugs in the game. If you wish to get involved with the community we have a steadily growing Discord group, as you can see in the image we have the return of the box head due to a user request from there. I am always happy to hear your thoughts and suggestions.

There are a bunch of changes in this update, I'll list some of them below. After this we will be expanding the hall and adding new machines!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Sumo Bot to make the multiplier easier to read
[*] Added tutorial boards for every controller
[*] Added a button to show controller bindings (you can also change the bindings yourself through steamvr settings)
[*] Added crouch for Oculus users
[*] Changed default grip on vive to toggle
[*] Made the ring-pull on cans open with a pinch gesture
[*] Fixed every gift shop item
[*] Changed default finger range
[*] Removed the teleport prompt rumble
[*] Added snapping to balls to make throwing easier
[*] Removed the buzz wire toy (might come back later)
[*] Added a missing toy from the prize shelf
[*] Basketballs that bounce out of the hoop no longer count
[/list]







[spoiler] Super Secret Easter Egg	[/spoiler]

notes.title: Update 9/7/19
notes.content:
[b]Added options panel[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjustable Walk Speed (Set to 0 if you only want to teleport)
[*] Language Options (For future translations)
[/list]

[b]Windows Mixed Reality[/b]
[list]
[*] Partial support added, you can play most of the game with some minor differences due to no skeleton support.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Prevent teleporting into machines
[*] Reduced volume of token dispensers
[*] Quit button takes you to the outdoor scene instead of quitting the app. You can quit the app from the outdoor scene or by pressing Escape at any time.
[*] Fixed game info panels showing wrong info
[/list]

notes.title: Update 5/7/19
notes.content:
[b]Alien Invasion[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Achievements
[*] Removed an exploit
[*] Cleared the crazy high scores off the leaderboards
[/list]

[b]Double Hands Bug[/b]
[list]
[*] Shouldn't see these on any controllers anymore
[/list]


Going forwards there will probably be more leaderboard wipes as more exploits are fixed.

notes.title: Update 3/7/19
notes.content:
[b]Re-added LabRush[/b]
[list]
[*] This is a complicated time management game where balls need to be routed correctly and speed up over time.
[*] Score multiple balls without dropping any for a higher combo.
[/list]

[b]Curling Table Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Glass panel is longer now to make it harder to cheat
[*] New stones will spawn when you get a perfect score meaning unlimited high scores
[*] Fixed an issue with the collider on the table
[*] Curling pays out more tokens
[*] Curling stones are heavier on the bottom now
[/list]

[b]Snap Turn Tutorial[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a tutorial board to the first scene for snap turning
[/list]

[b]Physical Buttons Tweak[/b]
[list]
[*] Now it should be easier to rapidly tap the paint drop button
[/list]

[b]Ostrich Racing Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Ostriches are twice as fast now
[*] Player one ostrich colour changed to match the border colour
[/list]

[b]Drinks Machines[/b]
[list]
[*] All drinks can be opened
[/list]

[b]Frog Frenzy[/b]
[list]
[*] Mallet now snaps to the correct orientation
[*] You can't hit frogs in the hole anymore
[/list]

[b]Music Miner[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the penalty for missing a key
[*] Prevent you from pressing 2 keys at once
[/list]

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Made it harder to accidentally open the leaderboards
[*] Only one person can upload scores and get tokens at a time
[*] Added a cooldown on the number of times you can download leaderboards
[/list]

Look out for new machines in future updates, head to Discord to tell us what to add ːsteamhappyː:PierheadSumo::supershoot:

notes.title: Update 1/7/19
notes.content:
[b]Added snap turning[/b]
Press B on index or Menu on Vive or B on Rift
You will turn in the direction of the controller

[b]Updated controller bindings[/b]
You should be able to shoot with Rift now and grab the guns with grip on vive

Hidden Lab Rush until we can redo the mechanics
